coverage_questions: The paper and atlas seed document one TISSUENARRATOR model with seven task/configuration trajectories: spatial-sentence fine-tuning, conditional generation, unconditional generation, neighborhood-composition perturbation, genetic perturbation, quantitative expression reconstruction, and conversational Q&A fine-tuning/inference.
The exact tokenizer vocabulary, serialization delimiters, special tokens, attention masks, prompt templates, decoding settings, and omitted equations are not documented in the supplied paper text.

The paper documents traversal by distance-weighted sequential sampling, but the literal probability equation is omitted. The traversal is represented with the catalog sampling operation and retains the unresolved source-defined details.

The paper documents a dataset-specific linear mapping from gene rank to expression, but the catalog has no exact operation for applying that fitted rank-to-value mapping. It remains an unexpanded boundary.

operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The paper states that fitted dataset-specific linear parameters convert predicted gene ranks into quantitative expression estimates. The catalog has no operation for applying this source-defined rank-to-value mapping; project represents a learned feature-space mapping and does not establish the documented reconstruction interface.

evidence.quote: On an input tissue section, TISSUENARRATOR starts by transforming each cell into the natural language space by encoding gene expression as 'cell sentences', a list of genes ranked by gene expression level. All cell sentences in a tissue patch are then assembled into a 1D 'spatial sentence', where cells are serialized by proximitybased traversal. This spatial sentence then serves as the input for fine-tuning an LLM to learn cell generation through next-token prediction.
Each spatial sentence S j is tokenized into tokens w 1 , w 2 , . . . , w T , where w t denotes the token at position t .
We fine-tune the Qwen3-4B-Base model [40] using the Unsloth framework [41].

evidence.quote: To evaluate TISSUENARRATOR's ability to apply biological prior knowledge and learned spatial knowledge in a Q&A setting, we constructed a proof-of-concept dataset covering three tasks
We split the dataset by structure name, fine-tuned TISSUENARRATOR, and evaluated the model on questions derived from held-out structures.
List the major cell classes present in the Dorsal peduncular area region from the mouse brain (include up to five).
Provide a concise scientific summary of the brain division 'cranial nerves' from the mouse brain. Describe its overall functional role and highlight representative structures and their significance.
